fixes: Replace the exactly-one AXStandardWindow check with saved-document identity or unique non-minimized main-window evidence for unsaved sets.
Recognize alternate window subroles and multiple views of the same saved document; reject distinct documents, unknown targets, dialogs and minimized sets.
Automatically inspect when Choose Live Set opens; provide Retry inspection and in-app technical evidence without requiring Terminal.
Distinguish the old window-identification error from Accessibility and Automation permission errors.
Preserve actionable confirmation errors and label an asynchronous save as requested rather than completed.
